light.completionGate:
NS 추가 구현 범위 · M3 진행 조건

이번 확장: 실제 R/Z/T 1차·2차·혼합 미분, 공분산·가중치의 1차 미분, 조건부 국소 전체 curl, Lean 미분 대수 정리.

정확식과 수렴하는 잔여항 경계를 제공합니다. 정밀 수치 도함수의 구간 계산, 실행한 밴드의 가중치 양성, 전역 물리 잔차·flat-error의 연결은 아직 완료되지 않았습니다.

M3는 대기 중입니다. 요청한 M2의 추가 완료 조건을 먼저 검증한 다음 P7→P8, Y5→Y6→Y7, N6→N7→N8의 선행 조건에 맞춰 진행합니다. 기존 원문 64개 기준의 검증 기록은 이 추가 조건의 완료 증거로 사용하지 않습니다.

band.allBandImplementation: actualBackgroundDyadicPrefix constructs actual n=1..ell and proves every n>=ell+1 inactive. The same operator code then constructs both source phases, constrained Volterra solutions and H integrals.
band.efficientAnchorImplementation: actualBackgroundSymbolicPrefix uses the same canonical coefficients but proves a much larger exact dyadic band from one cutoff scale.

exactInactiveTail.proof: q>=2^(-ell-1) and c_n>=2^n imply c_n*q>=1 for every integer n>=ell+1. The complete smooth cutoff and all its derivatives vanish.

domain.derivative: partial_R at fixed pulse time, source representative, dyadic Q, integer carrier and auxiliary label
domain.integralDerivative: Ordinary first slow derivative on the fixed compact pulse interval; exact functional construction and factorial enclosure, not evaluated decimal quadrature.
domain.inverse: Only on det(H) != 0; the identity is rational, not an unconditional invertibility assertion.

slowPoint.certifiedNearbySlowPoint: For perturbation conclusions the slow point is in the same selected box, at slow Euclidean distance<=4/S^3 from its frozen representative. The two points are not arbitrary independent choices.
slowPoint.domain: Image of [s=1/2..2, X=Xa/2..2Xb, eta=-1..1]; tau>=0. Comparisons use profile-coordinate paths, not unproved convexity of this slow image.

domain.sourceCertifiedPositiveDomain: The existing original family theorem separately applies for ell>=ellMinimum (q<qStar), in the same selected box and open stress annulus Xa<X<Xb.
domain.sourceNormDomain: Actual completed background on the enlarged source chart [Xa/2,2Xb] x eta[-1,1] x s[1/2,2]; boundary derivatives are one-sided.
domain.squareRootWeights: No square roots of inverse weights are constructed or declared positive for the exercised member.

band.allBandImplementation: actualBackgroundDyadicPrefix constructs actual n=1..ell and proves every n>=ell+1 inactive. The same operator code then constructs both source phases, constrained Volterra solutions and H integrals.
band.efficientAnchorImplementation: actualBackgroundSymbolicPrefix uses the same canonical coefficients but proves a much larger exact dyadic band from one cutoff scale.

exactInactiveTail.proof: q>=2^(-ell-1) and c_n>=2^n imply c_n*q>=1 for every integer n>=ell+1. The complete smooth cutoff and all its derivatives vanish.

domain.chartBoundary: Continuous one-sided derivative extensions on the original chart boundary; no differentiability across representative/carrier selection changes.
domain.derivative: Ordinary first and symmetric second R/Z/T partial derivatives with fixed band, representative, integer carrier and auxiliary label.
domain.localUniformity: Joint continuity on interior slow neighborhoods gives bounded FTC envelopes on compact neighborhoods and locally uniform differentiated Volterra convergence.
domain.normScope: Parameter-dependent exact FTC envelopes, uniform along the finite pulse interval. No common bound over all slow points, representatives or bands is inferred.
domain.numericalMeaning: Root IDs represent exact convergent expressions and exact finite integrals. Neither the norms nor derivatives are reported as evaluated decimal enclosures.
domain.regularity: The finite active smooth source recipe and original nonzero phase/frame denominators are retained. The envelopes actually contain each M_ij and its v derivative.

slowPoint.certifiedNearbySlowPoint: For perturbation conclusions the slow point is in the same selected box, at slow Euclidean distance<=4/S^3 from its frozen representative. The two points are not arbitrary independent choices.
slowPoint.domain: Image of [s=1/2..2, X=Xa/2..2Xb, eta=-1..1]; tau>=0. Comparisons use profile-coordinate paths, not unproved convexity of this slow image.

additionalConditions: R>0 and the original moving-frame denominators are nonzero.
det(H) != 0 and both original y=H^-1*T weights are strictly positive.
The same selected slow box and frozen representative are used throughout differentiation.

band.allBandImplementation: actualBackgroundDyadicPrefix constructs actual n=1..ell and proves every n>=ell+1 inactive. The same operator code then constructs both source phases, constrained Volterra solutions and H integrals.
band.efficientAnchorImplementation: actualBackgroundSymbolicPrefix uses the same canonical coefficients but proves a much larger exact dyadic band from one cutoff scale.

exactInactiveTail.proof: q>=2^(-ell-1) and c_n>=2^n imply c_n*q>=1 for every integer n>=ell+1. The complete smooth cutoff and all its derivatives vanish.

domain.chartBoundary: Continuous one-sided derivative extensions on the original chart boundary; no differentiability across representative/carrier selection changes.
domain.conclusion: A conditional exact local full potential curl. Its displayed expression is not a numerical value or an unconditional physical solution.
domain.derivative: Ordinary first and symmetric second R/Z/T partial derivatives with fixed band, representative, integer carrier and auxiliary label.
domain.localUniformity: Joint continuity on interior slow neighborhoods gives bounded FTC envelopes on compact neighborhoods and locally uniform differentiated Volterra convergence.
domain.normScope: Parameter-dependent exact FTC envelopes, uniform along the finite pulse interval. No common bound over all slow points, representatives or bands is inferred.
domain.numericalMeaning: Root IDs represent exact convergent expressions and exact finite integrals. Neither the norms nor derivatives are reported as evaluated decimal enclosures.
domain.regularity: The finite active smooth source recipe and original nonzero phase/frame denominators are retained. The envelopes actually contain each M_ij and its v derivative.

slowPoint.certifiedNearbySlowPoint: For perturbation conclusions the slow point is in the same selected box, at slow Euclidean distance<=4/S^3 from its frozen representative. The two points are not arbitrary independent choices.
slowPoint.domain: Image of [s=1/2..2, X=Xa/2..2Xb, eta=-1..1]; tau>=0. Comparisons use profile-coordinate paths, not unproved convexity of this slow image.

domain.support: One fixed-band, fixed-box source rectangle with original transverse chi and longitudinal psi. Slow band/mesh gluing and all-index physical assembly are separate.
domain.zeroStressBoundary: No square-root division at y=0 is evaluated. Extending through the zero-stress edge needs the separate flat-jet theorem.
